method: Frozen-data display and exact specification diagrams; no simulations, refits or bootstrap

10A.note: No isotonic refit or bootstrap. Lines connect observed pooled points only; shaded strip is the archived crossing CI.
10A.selector: dense-range archived pooled responses by architecture; frozen crossing and CI

crossings.censoring_note: Left-censored below the observed dense range; no in-range crossing is estimable and none may be extrapolated.

10B.note: Descriptive master means; masking has action denominator, modal classification has learner denominator.

1A-1B.note: No quantitative values; arrows organize model mechanisms, not estimated causal effects in children.

2.note: Specification diagram. Turnover is restricted to current Accepted; escape to non-redeemed Stigmatized paths.

3A-3D.note: Schematic only. K=3 is illustrative, not an additional simulated condition.

4A.selector: lambda in {0.5,2.5}; p=.65; equal-weight means of five masters

5A.selector: p in {.75,.85}; all five disclosure levels

5B.note: Var(R)=9(1-p)d[1-(1-p)d]; does not establish a learner variance preference.
5B.selector: exact reward variance at plotted disclosure levels

5C.note: Archived REGRET is binary-minus-graded normalized regret, exactly graded-minus-binary mean disclosure. Units multiply the unit-scale quantities by 100; time windows differ by outcome.
5C.selector: all four claims, with REGRET re-expressed as mean-disclosure difference

6A.note: Bars use midpoint; numerical brackets have width 0.00006103515625, not statistical confidence intervals.
6A.selector: all three bracketed thresholds plus exact static boundary

6B.note: Bars equal-weight master means; dots show individual archived master values.

7.note: Each square is a tested parameter cell. Inconclusive cells retained; no smoothing or inferred boundary.
7.selector: all 357 frozen publication_category rows; p21×eta17; no reclassification

8.note: 375 archived classifications; integer count display, not an uncertainty estimate. Gamma also changes the objective.
8.selector: component=sentinels; five explicit disagreement sentinels; 15 separate settings; five masters each

9A-9C,9E-9F.note: Equal-weight descriptive master means; connected lines guide the eye and do not imply intermediate K values. First success is zero-based and capped at T=2000 for non-events.
